Subject: Architecture deep-dive (private deployment) - request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick product overview last week. FinSecure is exploring Redwood for a private deployment (VPC-hosted or on-prem air-gapped) for our fraud detection pipeline. Before we get into procurement, our infra and security teams need a 60–90 minute architecture deep-dive to walk through network/topology options, KMS/HSM integrations, and operational controls (audit logs, SSO, data egress restrictions).

High-level requirements: VPC peering or PrivateLink, no outbound internet from inference cluster (air-gapped option), HSM-based key wrapping, SOC2 evidence for audit logs, and an ops runbook for patching/upgrades.

Would you be able to schedule a technical session this or next week? Our infra lead (Tom Bennett) and security lead will join. I can share a preliminary questionnaire and our network topology if that helps.

Best,
Anita

FinSecure Bank
